name: Sameer Africa Plc
source: Sameer Africa Plc audited consolidated financial results for the year ended 31 Dec 2025 (RSM Eastern Africa, unqualified, dated 14 Apr 2026) | CRON 20261014B: H1 2026 column read from Sameer Africa Plc unaudited financial results for the six months ended 30 June 2026, filed with the Nairobi Securities Exchange (KShs thousands read as absolute KES): Revenue 205,750; Other operating income 7,672; Operating expenses 83,332; Operating profit 130,090; Net finance cost 2,424; Share of profit of equity-accounted investee 14,519; Profit before income tax 142,185; Income tax expense 38,300; Profit for the period 103,885; basic and diluted EPS 0.37. Gates tie on the printed lines: 205,750 less 83,332 plus 7,672 equals the printed operating profit 130,090, and profit before income tax less income tax equals the printed profit 103,885. Cost of Sales and Gross Profit are left empty for this period because the interim statement prints no separate direct or property cost line, so a gross profit figure would not be the same measure as the stored years. Net Finance Costs is signed as the net finance income of the period, negative for a net cost. The published document carries no text layer, so the figures were read by OCR of the single published page. The half year EPS is the printed basic and diluted figure for the period, not annualised.
source_note: Summary consolidated statement of profit or loss. Source prints KShs'000; values x1000 to absolute KES.

reconciliation_note: Profit before income tax 340,421 - income tax 66,138 = profit for the year 274,283 (KShs'000). Operating Profit (EBIT) less Net Finance Costs plus Other Income equals Profit Before Tax does not hold in FY2025, FY2024: the statement bridges operating profit to profit before tax through further lines (Other Operating Income; Share of Profit of Equity-Accounted Investee) and the file's own bridge reproduces the filed profit before tax; both figures are shown unchanged.
